options.B: Debit 20,000 to Capital Account, Credit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account
options.C: Debit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account, Credit 20,000 to Drawings Account
options.D: Debit 20,000 to Drawings Account, Credit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account

questions.stem: A company has the following ledger accounts: Sales 100,000, Purchases 120,000. What is the correct journal entry to rectify the error?

options.A: Debit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account, Credit 20,000 to Capital Account
options.B: Debit 20,000 to Capital Account, Credit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account
options.C: Debit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account, Credit 20,000 to Drawings Account
options.D: Debit 20,000 to Drawings Account, Credit 20,000 to Profit and Loss Account
